integrity: Standalone source-code verification included; each embedded artifact has a byte count and SHA-256. The finite tests do not prove unrestricted quantifiers.
scientific_limitations: Finite full constant-chain powers with global quantifiers only. Not an assertion about arbitrary monadic Gödel algebras. Full historical novelty and independent mathematics review remain outstanding; a related ordinary Gödel hom-count paper was not available in full text.
title: Quantifier-rigid morphisms of finite functional monadic Gödel powers
